# gyro_server_snapshot_schedule (Resource)

Scheduled snapshots of a Gyro Cloud Istanbul (tr-ist-1) server (GET|PUT|DELETE /cloud/servers/{id}/snapshot-schedule, Gyro Public API 2.40.0). Every day or every week at hour:minute Türkiye time a snapshot named auto-YYYYMMDD-HHMM is taken; the oldest automatic snapshots are deleted so at most `keep` stay. Manual snapshots are never deleted but count toward the server's snapshot limit (when it is full the run is skipped, see last_status). Snapshots above the free allowance of a prepaid server are billed hourly. While the server has snapshots an extra disk (gyro_server_disk) cannot be grown: set enabled = false and delete the snapshots first. Destroy removes the schedule; existing snapshots stay.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every night at 03:30 (Türkiye time), keep the last 3 automatic snapshots.
resource "gyro_server_snapshot_schedule" "db" {
  server_id = tonumber(gyro_server.db.id)
  hour      = 3
  minute    = 30
  keep      = 3
}

# Weekly on Sunday 02:00, keep 4 (about a month).
resource "gyro_server_snapshot_schedule" "web" {
  server_id = tonumber(gyro_server.web.id)
  frequency = "weekly"
  weekday   = "sunday"
  hour      = 2
  keep      = 4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Gyro Cloud Istanbul server id (gyro_server.id).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) false pauses the schedule (kept).
- `frequency` (String) daily (default) or weekly.
- `hour` (Number) Hour, Türkiye time (Europe/Istanbul), default 3.
- `keep` (Number) Automatic snapshots to keep (1 to the server's snapshot limit, default 7).
- `minute` (Number) Minute, default 0.
- `weekday` (String) Day for frequency = weekly: sunday ... saturday (required then).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as server_id.
- `last_error` (String) Why the last run was skipped (e.g. snapshot_limit).
- `last_run_at` (String) Last run (RFC 3339, UTC) at the last read.
- `last_status` (String) queued (snapshot started) or skipped (see last_error) at the last read.
- `next_run_at` (String) Next run (RFC 3339, UTC) at the last read; empty when paused.
- `snapshot_limit` (Number) The server's snapshot limit (manual + automatic).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_server_snapshot_schedule.db 12345
```
